description: How much recent sales value sits on SKUs not mapped to a catalog master (so margin and COGS are wrong), the top unmapped SKUs, and per-channel diagnostics (orders found, stores no longer linked). Covers Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Snapdeal, Shopify, JioMart, Ajio, offline.

range.description: Sales window: 7d (default), 30d, or mtd. Prefer 7d; 30d can time out on large catalogs.

name: get_sku_mapping_health
title: SKU mapping health
